name: manual_9940e1
claim: Append-only historical records must never be rewritten in place, even to fix a real error -- including via checkout --theirs or any other whole-file overwrite during conflict resolution. The correct fix: restore the original record exactly, then append a new entry whose supersedes field names the original lesson id, carrying only the corrected claim text. checkout --theirs looks like a clean conflict resolution but is exactly the in-place-mutation this doctrine bans when applied to an append-only record file, not a regular source file.

decisions.notes: Self-caught via CodeRabbit review on PT PR #332 (pullrequestreview-4870396843): while reanchoring a stale branch's fix to lesson_e773f6f957c2 (itself the lesson documenting the append-only-record rule), resolved a merge conflict on the candidate JSON with 'git checkout --theirs', which overwrote the original record's claim/rationale fields in place with the commit's corrected wording -- a direct violation of the exact rule that record states, committed while fixing that record. lessons.jsonl's own entry for the same lesson id survived untouched only because the separate union-merge script deduped by id with 'first occurrence wins' and happened to keep main's original first; the standalone candidates/graduated/*.json file had no such protection since it was resolved by hand. Restored the original file exactly and superseded properly instead.
